This is a bomb cart trailer, a container chassis-type trailer towed by a terminal tractor, so it falls in heading 8716. Subheading 8716.39 covers other trailers and semi-trailers for the transport of goods. Within that, 8716.39.00 has statistical suffixes: 8716.39.0030 for "Other: Trailers designed for ... " Let me recall the actual structure.

8716.39 - Other:
- 8716.39.00 - Other trailers and semitrailers for the transport of goods
 - 8716.39.0010 Container chassis... Actually I recall 8716.39.0030 is "Trailers and semitrailers... Other: Trailers specially designed for carrying containers"? In the HTSUS, 8716.39.00 subdivides into 8716.39.0010 (Trailers and semitrailers of the van type, refrigerated), 8716.39.0020 (Other, van type), 8716.39.0030 (Tank trailers), 8716.39.0040 (Flatbed/ platform)... then 8716.39.0050 (Other). I'm fairly unsure. A bomb cart is a flat platform, no sides, with container guides, so it is a container-carrying flatbed chassis. 8716.39.0090 is "Other", which I believe is the safest.
